records.name: Swedish Institute Scholarship for Global Professionals
records.field_eligibility: Eligible English-taught master's programmes listed by the Swedish Institute.
records.nationality_eligibility: Citizens of countries eligible for the current SI scholarship call who meet work and leadership requirements.
records.tuition_coverage: Full tuition is paid directly by SI to the Swedish university.
records.accommodation_coverage: The monthly allowance is for living expenses, including housing.
records.travel_allowance: A one-time travel grant is included, with country-specific amounts.
records.health_insurance: Insurance is not included; applicants must check university coverage.
required_documents: References required by the current call
records.application_method: Apply to an eligible Swedish master's programme, then submit the separate SI scholarship application during the stated period.
records.notes: The current official page does not announce the next deadline.
eligibility_warnings: Only listed nationalities and programmes are eligible.

source.title: SI Scholarship for Global Professionals
source.relevant_excerpt: The scholarship covers full tuition, a monthly living allowance and a travel grant; insurance is excluded.

records.name: Singapore International Graduate Award SINGA
records.provider_name: Agency for Science, Technology and Research Singapore
records.field_eligibility: PhD research in science and engineering with participating Singapore research institutes and universities.
records.nationality_eligibility: International students applying for PhD study in Singapore for the first time, subject to the current SINGA conditions.
records.tuition_coverage: Tuition fees are covered for up to four years.
records.accommodation_coverage: The monthly stipend supports living costs; housing is not separately guaranteed.
records.travel_allowance: A one-time airfare grant is included.
records.health_insurance: Insurance terms must be checked in the current award conditions.
records.application_method: Apply through the official SINGA application system for the announced intake.
records.notes: The next intake deadline is intentionally left blank until officially published.
eligibility_warnings: This is a research PhD award, not a general master's scholarship.

source.title: A*STAR SINGA brochure
source.relevant_excerpt: Funding for up to four years includes tuition fees, monthly stipend, airfare grant and settling-in allowance.

records.name: Thailand International Postgraduate Programme TIPP
records.field_eligibility: Development-focused postgraduate programmes named in the annual Thailand International Postgraduate Programme call.
records.nationality_eligibility: Government officials and eligible candidates from the countries named in the current TICA call.
records.tuition_coverage: Tuition and supplementary fees are paid directly to the training institution.
records.accommodation_coverage: A settlement allowance and monthly living allowance are paid.
records.travel_allowance: An economy-class ticket to Bangkok is issued for each awardee.
records.health_insurance: Students must confirm current insurance terms in the programme call.
required_documents: Medical documents required by the current call
records.application_method: Apply through the annual TICA/TIPP process and the required nominating channel.
records.notes: The funding source is official; annual courses, nationalities and deadlines change.
eligibility_warnings: This award is limited to the annual TICA partner-country and nominee criteria.

source.title: TICA allowances and expenses
source.relevant_excerpt: Thailand bears settlement and monthly living allowances, tuition and supplementary fees, and economy airfare.

records.name: KAUST Fellowship — Master's
records.provider_name: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology
records.university_name: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology
records.field_eligibility: KAUST graduate science, engineering and technology master's programmes.
records.nationality_eligibility: International applicants who meet KAUST graduate admission requirements.
records.tuition_coverage: The fellowship covers full tuition and bench fees.
records.travel_allowance: Relocation support covers visa, relocation and travel costs.
records.application_method: Apply directly to KAUST graduate admissions.
records.notes: The award is university-funded, rather than a central Saudi-government scholarship; it is included because it meets the full-funding requirement.
eligibility_warnings: Benefits may differ for partnership or external-sponsorship admissions.

source.title: KAUST fees and funding
source.relevant_excerpt: The fellowship includes full tuition, a stipend, accommodation, health insurance and relocation support.
